name: Nautilo Design
description: Create and edit Nautilo-native vector designs — frames, text, shapes, ellipses, lines, polygons, and pen paths in .design.html. Generate SVG artwork for use outside the canvas.

agent.instructions: For an open Design document, inspect first, follow nextCursor until completeness is complete when the requested scope is larger than one response, and use only returned node:/page: handles or $refs created earlier in the same atomic batch. The host supplies the active-document binding and idempotency bookkeeping; do not invent or add those fields. Copy each referenced existing node/page semanticVersion into the exact preconditions array; create-only $refs need no precondition. Never invent or refresh a semanticVersion. Use one create operation for frames, text, rectangles, ellipses, common shapes, lines, and images. Image creation requires assetRef copied from inspect-image-asset or document inspection. Replace an image with op image, nodeId, and assetRef; include its semanticVersion precondition. Closed shapes use positive x, y, width, and height. Lines use explicit start and end points, including horizontal, vertical, and reverse directions. name is optional on every creation family. On creation, style.stroke null means no stroke while omission preserves the default. Every create/path-create/connector operation must set pageId to an inspected page: handle and include that page's semanticVersion precondition; top-level creation also sets parentId to null, while child creation sets parentId to an inspected node: handle or earlier node $ref. The implicit default page is not allowed for live semantic edits because it is not stale-safe. If the document version becomes stale, the trusted host automatically applies the exact approved batch only when all inspection-derived semantic preconditions still match. Disjoint stale recovery needs no second model call or approval. A changed target or dependency returns semantic_conflict with stateChanged false, retrySafe false, and recovery action ask_user; ask the human before forming a new edit. The host alone handles an exact lost-response replay. Pen paths use normalized node-local coordinates from 0 to 1 with M, L, C, and Z commands plus separate document-space bounds. To revise a Pen path, inspect with includeGeometry and send the returned normalized commands unchanged as expectedGeometry.

tools.title: Inspect open Design
tools.description: Inspect the canonical scene bound to the active Design session. Returns bounded page/node handles with opaque semanticVersion preconditions, model-space bounds and appearance, connector endpoints, selection validation, and optionally normalized node-local M/L/C/Z Pen geometry. Copy semanticVersion only for the existing handles referenced by a later edit. Follow nextCursor until completeness is complete. Accepts no target, path, DOM selector, renderer ID, or pointer input.

tools.title: Edit open Design
tools.description: Apply one atomic operation batch to the exact active Design document and return a handles-only receipt. The host supplies session and idempotency fields, automatically performs disjoint stale recovery from exact semantic preconditions, and owns exact lost-response replay. Inspect first and include exact preconditions copied from semanticVersion for every existing public handle referenced by the operations; $refs created in this batch are exempt. A changed dependency returns semantic_conflict with recovery action ask_user. Use create for frames, text, rectangles, ellipses, common shapes, and lines. Closed shapes require positive bounds; lines require explicit start and end. Every creation requires an inspected pageId and its precondition. Top-level creation sets parentId null. name is optional at creation, and style.stroke null creates without a stroke. Pen creation and revision use 2–2048 normalized node-local M/L/C/Z commands plus document-space bounds. Accepts no target, path, DOM selector, SVG, pointer event, or filesystem input.

preconditions.description: Exact inspection-derived semantic preconditions for every existing public handle referenced by the operations. Object creation always includes its explicit inspected page precondition; only a new-page-only batch may use an empty array. Copy semanticVersion from inspection; never invent or refresh it after a stale refusal.

oneOf.description: Create a frame, text, rectangle, ellipse, common shape, or line. Closed shapes use positive x/y/width/height. Lines use start/end. name and style are applied in this same operation.

assetRef.description: Exact ref returned by inspect-image-asset or current document inspection; never a URL or inline image.

oneOf.description: Create a Pen path when nodeId is omitted; creation requires an inspected pageId. Revise an inspected path when nodeId and expectedGeometry are supplied.
Move or resize nodes; each update nodeId is a node: handle or same-batch $ref.
Rotate one or more node: handles or same-batch $refs.
Rename one node: handle or same-batch $ref.
Edit text properties on one node: handle or same-batch $ref.
Edit fill, border, opacity, or radius on node: handles or same-batch $refs.
Align at least two node: handles or same-batch $refs.
Distribute at least three node: handles or same-batch $refs.
Set the complete child order. Use parentId null plus pageId for a page, or a parent handle/$ref.
Combine at least two nodes; ref may name the result for later same-batch edits.
Create a page; ref labels the created page in the receipt. Placement operations use inspected page: handles.
Create a connector on the required inspected pageId; endpoint targetHandle values may be node: handles or same-batch $refs.
Update one connector by node: handle or same-batch $ref.

tools.description: Read a known Workspace raster artifact and return its pinned assetRef, name, and dimensions. Use the internal artifact UUID from Workspace discovery. Bytes stay in host custody. Use the exact returned ref with create node type image or image replacement. PNG, JPEG, and WebP still images are supported; changed, missing, unauthorized, or animated images fail explicitly.

Create an empty Nautilo Design document from the trusted Design template. filename is a basename ending in .design.html, never a path. workspace creates in the authenticated conversation's authorized workspace (Personal in an ordinary private conversation); the caller cannot choose a Room or path. currentFolder creates beside the active Current Folder and fails when that host surface is unavailable. The returned target identifies the created document; this tool does not claim to open it.

tools.title: Inspect design document
tools.description: Inspect a Nautilo Design document — pages, top-level frames, node count, and an optional per-node summary.
Create a frame node on a page (or as a child of another node) and persist the document.
Create a text node with the given text content and optional font styling.
Create a rectangle shape node. Other shape kinds are not yet available through this tool.
Update properties of an existing node (geometry, style, text fields). Only listed fields are accepted.
Replace the text content of a text node.
Align or distribute existing sibling nodes by intent. The tool computes geometry from the canonical scene; do not supply coordinates.
Reorder the children of a parent node (or the top-level children of a page when parentId is null). The provided nodeIds must exactly match the existing child set.
Export a canonical .design.html document as a persisted Workspace SVG file. The server renders the parsed Nautilo scene; it never writes arbitrary iframe SVG bytes.

Export a canonical .design.html page, frame or selection as a PNG artifact. Uses exact bundled-font outlines; ambient fonts and unresolved images fail explicitly. The server validates and rasterizes the canonical scene, preserving destination authority and collision recovery.
